MyOS reseller clause edition of 0.4.0-preview.3. The per-document clause type registry is removed; definitions are selected through each clause type reference. Business specifications are documentation, not new native runtime bindings. Root specification overrides are removed. Participants accepts either an existing External Channel or the pinned authenticated Coordination Timeline Channel. The unvalidated amendment request has no inherited child metadata. Uses the original, unmodified Language, BEX, Contracts and Coordination packages.
